title: The Cuntz-Pimsner algebra of the simplest Motzkin subproduct system is 2-subhomogeneous
summary: The Motzkin subproduct system (SPS) is constructed from the Jones Wenzl idempotents of the Motzkin algebras, which generalizes the Temperley Lieb SPS. The simplest Motzkin SPS, which is not a Temperley Lieb SPS, is constructed from a 3 dimensional Hilbert space. We explicitly describe the spectrum of the corresponding Cuntz Pimsner algebra, which remarkably admits only irreducible representations of dimensions 1 and 2, and can thus be viewed as a mildly quantum space.
